Firebomb Hellpods

From Helldivers Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search
Boosters
Firebomb Hellpods
“

Lines all Hellpods with volatile incendiaries that detonate upon impact, igniting any units in vicinity of the drop site.

— Armory Description

Firebomb Hellpods is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, all Hellpods (manned or unmanned), will detonate upon impact with the surface. Due to the nature of the booster, and its potential damage, notify all squadmates of its use in order to minimize friendly fire.

Description

Firebomb Hellpods is a Booster designed to damage any entity that is near a Hellpod drop site. Upon contact with the surface, a small explosion will occur, dealing both explosive and incendiary damage. Since it affects every Hellpod deployed by the squad, caution must be taken in order to prevent friendly fire or accidents, espcially during initial deployments, when the entire squad is equipping themselves.

Procurement

The Firebomb Hellpods Booster is unlocked on the 3rd page of the Freedom's Flame Premium Warbond for 60 Medals.

Tactical Information

  • The Firebomb Hellpods is not recommended for smaller missions areas, such as Evacuate High-Value Assets, where space is limited and the necessity to deploy multiple Hellpod-deployed stratagems are required for effective coverage.
    • All sentries are deployed using Hellpods, so deploying them in close proximity to one another will result in the destruction of the nearby one.
  • If equipped, notify fellow squadmates of its usage, as it will allow them to adjust their throws, either to ensure maximum enemy elimiations, or to prevent accidental friendly fire, espcially when calling support-related stratagems.
